source_access_rule.required: Each reviewer must read every canonical source and required repo input directly. Summaries are navigation aids, not substitutes.

progressive_disclosure_review_order.guiding_principle: Orient first, then review in dependency order. The short Mature End State orientation supplies a common map, but the full Mature End State is reviewed only after its Production Maturity Baseline, Workspace, and Control Room dependencies so it cannot anchor or pre-decide them.

pass_0_orientation.purpose: Establish authority, source versions, reviewer lenses, claim labels, rubric, non-goals, meeting procedure, and output contract.

pass_0_orientation.scope: executive decision, north star, integrated product roles, Mature Foundation milestone, four-to-six-month mature horizon, and evidence-gated framing only
pass_0_orientation.purpose: Give every reviewer the same whole-system map before detailed reading.

pass_1_full_dependency_review.reason: The governing production, evidence, security, release, restore, and Unknown-semantics floor constrains every product decision.
The primary business product establishes the people, routines, records, surfaces, adoption obligations, and business outcomes the rest of the system serves.
The operational and safety counterpart is intelligible only after the business system it observes, explains, protects, approves, and verifies is understood.
The umbrella end state depends on the other three and is reviewed last as a synthesis and contradiction check, not as an anchoring answer.

pass_2_cross_cutting_proposals.reason: Set the independent owner-controlled platform-versus-tenant identity before evaluating scaled access or runtime branding.
Set the human seat, workspace, membership, and business-data isolation model before evaluating any runtime that acts inside it.
Set the system-file placement and Cowork-retirement boundary before deciding which persistent runtime orchestrates the Drive-free system.
Evaluate Hermes and Portal only after platform identity, workspace isolation, Drive independence, authority, source-truth, and risk boundaries are known.

pass_3_machine_evidence_and_reconciliati.source: Workspace Phase 0 contracts, fixtures, prototype, validator, tests, and verifier evidence
pass_3_machine_evidence_and_reconciliati.purpose: Test roadmap claims against the prepared business-product contracts and runnable evidence.

pass_3_machine_evidence_and_reconciliati.source: Control Room Phase 0 contracts, fixtures, prototype, validator, tests, and verifier evidence
pass_3_machine_evidence_and_reconciliati.purpose: Test roadmap claims against the prepared operational, identity, authority, audit, and safety contracts.
Resolve cross-roadmap contradictions and disposition PROP-001 through PROP-010 only after the full source and evidence passes.

anti_anchoring_rules: No score, fork disposition, roadmap amendment, or proceed verdict may be recorded during pass 0.
No reviewer may skip, reorder, or substitute a summary for a full pass-1 source.
A reviewer may take provisional notes during reading, but must revisit them after completing pass 1 before submitting the sealed review.

Hermes and Portal are evaluated after naming, workspace isolation, and Drive independence because a runtime cannot define its own platform identity, data boundary, system-file placement, authority, recovery plane, or source of truth.
The full Mature End State must be checked against the Baseline, Workspace, and Control Room; a conflict is not resolved merely because the umbrella document states a preference.
progressive_disclosure_review_order.review_completion_checkpoint: Before scoring or disposition, each reviewer must attest that pass 0 was used only for orientation and that every pass-1 source was read in the declared order at the exact frozen version.

single_session_council_orchestration.controlling_mode: One human-visible Claude Fable 5 session may chair the entire council and invoke GPT-5.6 Sol and SuperGrok 4.5 through fresh isolated CLI reviewer contexts.

execution_order.action: Run facilitator preflight, verify the frozen commit and source generations, confirm CLI access to both external reviewer seats, and record the evidence manifest.

Freeze the Fable review with a content hash or immutable transcript location.

Validate and freeze both returned review forms before exposing any review to another seat or beginning deliberation.

As non-voting chair, write the disposition ledger and Joe approval card without inventing consensus, erasing dissent, or treating the council as final authority.

isolation_requirements: Each CLI reviewer starts with a fresh context and receives no prior reviewer output.
Each seat reads the same exact sources in the same progressive-disclosure order and returns the same schema.
Tool or subprocess logs must distinguish reviewer identity, model, prompt version, source commit, start and finish time, and output hash.
A failed, truncated, source-missing, or schema-invalid review is rerun in a fresh context or recorded as missing evidence; the chair may not complete it on that reviewer's behalf.
single_session_council_orchestration.stop_condition: If the Fable session cannot prove fresh-context isolation for Codex and Grok, cannot give them the exact frozen source set, or sees one review before its own is frozen, stop and restart the affected sealed-review stage rather than improvising consensus.

meeting_protocol.name: facilitator preflight
procedure: verify exact commit and doctrine generations
verify all required sources are readable
record missing evidence
confirm Workspace 32/32 and Control Room 94/94 or record changed evidence
confirm no proposal is represented as approved
require each reviewer to acknowledge the progressive-disclosure order and its no-scoring orientation restriction
meeting_protocol.exit: one frozen evidence manifest and three review-order acknowledgements

meeting_protocol.name: sealed independent reviews
procedure: each reviewer works without seeing another review
each follows pass 0 through pass 3 in the declared order without scoring or disposition during orientation
each reviews all ten forks through its assigned primary lens and every critical rubric dimension
each submits the uniform review form
facilitator locks the three outputs before disclosure
meeting_protocol.exit: three complete independent reviews with source-order attestations

meeting_protocol.name: evidence normalization
procedure: facilitator extracts agreements, disagreements, missing evidence, and source contradictions
no reviewer changes a position during normalization
facts are cited to exact source and claim label

meeting_protocol.name: fork rounds
procedure: review PROP-001 through PROP-010 in order
lead reviewer is the seat whose lens is most material
other seats challenge once each
facilitator records proposed disposition, contract changes, safe interim default, and dissent

meeting_protocol.name: cross-roadmap contradiction sweep
procedure: test every candidate disposition against all three roadmaps and the Production Maturity Baseline
check terminology, roles, states, authority, data, timelines, costs, platform order, hardware, Hermes, human-workspace scaling, and adoption gates
do not repair one roadmap while leaving another contradictory

meeting_protocol.name: program and evidence gate review
procedure: separate current verified state from approved design, proposed design, and future evidence
confirm Phase 0 exit evidence
confirm Phase 1 entry order
preserve elapsed observation windows and human acceptance gates
meeting_protocol.exit: ordered work packages and gate ledger

meeting_protocol.name: dissent and compression round
procedure: each reviewer states the strongest remaining objection in no more than three items
each states what evidence would change its view
facilitator preserves minority positions and removes duplicate prose without deleting disagreement

meeting_protocol.name: non-voting synthesis
procedure: facilitator fills the disposition ledger template
validate every required field
produce roadmap amendments, contradiction results, open gates, and one Joe approval card
do not invent consensus or decide for Joe

facilitation_rules: Independent reviews remain sealed until all three are complete.
The facilitator is not a fourth vote and cannot silently add a preferred architecture.
A majority does not override a substantiated critical security, authority, source-truth, release, restore, or evidence objection.
No reviewer may cite another review as primary evidence; cite the underlying source.
Absence of evidence is Unknown, not Healthy, approved, complete, or zero.
A proposal may be accepted only with exact downstream contract and roadmap changes.
A deferral requires owner, reopen trigger, safe interim default, and blocked scope.
Dissent is preserved in the final ledger even when Joe later chooses another path.
Cost and ROI forecasts remain hypotheses until measured against the five approved baselines.
The final output recommends; Joe approves.
known_open_evidence: Joe's five uncoached Workspace journeys are not performed.
Joe's six uncoached Control Room flows are not performed.
The five operating baselines remain unknown pending instrumentation or interview.
Responsive, keyboard, screen-reader, sterile-mode, and Color Assist evidence is incomplete.
Workspace and Control Room each retain the known duplicate ordinal-2 metadata defect under system loop 315; it is not represented as repaired.
The doctrine Markdown cutoff remains a separate NO-GO until its evidence, consumer, deployment, and Joe-approval gates pass.
Hermes R0 is only a proposed constrained evaluation; live data, scheduling, delivery, durable request creation, dispatch, mutation, and external effects remain separately gated.
A final independent platform name has not been selected.
Mac mini purchase and activation remain separate evidence-gated decisions.
Drive-free system operation is proposed, not yet proven; the complete executable and installed-consumer inventory plus the 48-hour disconnected-Drive test remain open.
